title: 第25章 个个都是人才第26章 异端
slug: 老师是个多周目速通玩家
lines: 地宫第七层。
珲伍被丢进了一座积水漫过膝盖的牢房里，玄铁牢门重重关上。
虽然这是主线流程的必经剧情，但每次一回到密大学院就被那个女人捆起来当狗一样丢进地宫监狱，珲伍还是会感到不爽。
好消息是，这一周目没法速通了，他后面有的是机会狠狠踩那女人的头。
戴黑色面具、腿长一米八的女人名叫杜娅。
绰号渡鸦，是密大学院的院内执事长。
执事团是密大学院内的私人军团，对外部门负责清剿南部异端教派，对内部门兼管院内戒律。
说白了就是保安大队，而负责院内事务的杜娅，其实就相当于保安队长。
密大学院在南部的地位非常高，且特殊。
各大国度的皇室子嗣都会被派遣到这里来学习，而密大学院还负责监管南部各地的教派信仰。
这样一个特殊的存在，难免就会成为异端教派渗透的对象。
所以，执事团的任务就变得非常重要，即便只是院内执事团，光是为了确保密大学院内部人员的“干净”
，他们就有干不完的活。
这里几乎每年都会曝出院系学徒甚至导师与外界异端教派勾结的丑闻，而这些被揪出来的异端分子，无一例外都被丢进了地宫监牢。
差不多跟珲伍这会儿是一个待遇。
至于说为什么不把他们直接给烧死呢？
没有背景的异端当然是一把火烧了干净，可能够进入密大学院求学乃至任教的，哪一个背后不是站着一方豪族，甚至可能是某国的皇室。
对付这种人，即便是有确凿证据证明他与异端教派有染，也是没法抬上火刑架的，就只能先关着了。
日积月累，地宫监牢就成了群英荟萃的聚集地。
这里边个个都是人才，说话又好听……
“新来的！
会不会嗦niuzi！”
一道粗犷的声音从珲伍牢门外传来。
那动静来自于第七层最深处的那间牢房。
在他对珲伍发出灵魂质问的同时，珲伍的玄铁牢门外还传来重物锤击的闷响。
珲伍所在的牢房距离第七层最深处的那间隔着有几十米远。
按理来说，狱友发来亲切问候很正常，但不应该能敲得到他的牢门才对。
“问你话呢！
老子今天心情不错，给你个表现的机会！”
content_en:
Bang——
The seventh floor of the underground palace.
Hui Wu was thrown into a cell with water up to his knees, and the black iron cell door was slammed shut.
Although this is a necessary plot in the main plot, Huiwu still feels unhappy every time he is tied up by the woman like a dog and thrown into the underground prison as soon as he returns to the University of Michigan.
The good news is that there is no way to speed pass this game, and there will be plenty of opportunities for him to stomp on that woman's head.
The woman wearing a black mask and with 1.8-meter-long legs is named Duya.
Nicknamed Raven, he is the deacon of the University of Michigan.
The Deacon Corps is a private corps within the University of Michigan. The external department is responsible for suppressing heretical sects in the south, and the internal department is also responsible for the discipline of the campus.
To put it bluntly, it is the security brigade, and Du Ya, who is responsible for the affairs of the hospital, is actually equivalent to the security captain.
The University of Michigan's status in the South is very high and special.
The royal heirs of all major countries will be sent here to study, and the University of Michigan College is also responsible for supervising sectarian beliefs in various parts of the south.
Such a special existence will inevitably become the target of infiltration by heretical sects.
Therefore, the mission of the deacons has become very important, even if it is just the deacons within the college, it is just to ensure that the internal staff of the University of Michigan are "clean"
, they have endless work to do.
Almost every year, scandals involving college apprentices and even mentors colluding with outside heretical sects are exposed here, and these heretics who are found out are all thrown into the underground palace prison without exception.
He is almost on the same level as Hui Wu at the moment.
As for why not just burn them to death?
Of course, heretics with no background are burned out with fire. They may be able to study in the University of Michigan or even teach. Behind each of them is not a wealthy family, or even the royal family of a certain country.
To deal with such a person, even if there is conclusive evidence that he has an affair with a heretical sect, there is no way to put him on the stake, so he can only be locked up first.
Over time, the underground palace prison became a gathering place for heroes.
Everyone here is talented and speaks nicely...
"New here!
Will it be embarrassing! "
A rough voice came from outside the door of Huiwu Prison.
The movement came from the cell at the deepest level of the seventh floor.
While he was questioning Hui Wu's soul, the muffled sound of heavy objects hammering could be heard outside Hui Wu's black iron prison door.
The cell where Hui Wu was located was dozens of meters away from the deepest part of the seventh floor.
Logically speaking, it is normal for inmates to send cordial greetings, but they should not be able to knock on his cell door.
"I'm asking you something!
I'm in a good mood today and I'll give you a chance to show off! "
